Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Part-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
Tasks
Implementing IP-based network solutions.
Configuring network security standards and best practices.
Configuring and maintaining network zones and access control policies.
Managing and configuring firewall systems.
Implementing and operating proxy solutions to ensure secure and monitored web access.
Supporting secure connectivity for SAP systems using SAP Router.
Reviewing, optimizing, and maintaining security rule sets and configurations.
Collaborating with other IT/security teams and business units to ensure alignment of infrastructure with security and business requirements.
 Qualifications
 Must haves:
Theoretical expertise of IP-based networks
Knowledge of network (Cisco) or security (Checkpoint) equipment
Knowledge of LAN, WAN and Wireless technologies
Curiosity and willingness to learn
Familiarity with network zone concepts (e.g., DMZ, internal, external, restricted zones).
Having a positive attitude and showing initiative
Being able to work well within a team, but also individually
 Nice-to-haves:
Hands on experience on Cisco LAN, WAN and Wireless equipment
Hands on experience on Checkpoint Management Console
 Things to know before departure: 
Start: by arrangement - always on the 1st and 15th of the month
Working hours: part-time (20h); 27 vacation days
Employment contract: Unlimited
Line of work: Consulting 
Language skills: Fluency in written and spoken German (B2-C1) & English (B2)
Flexibility & willingness to travel
Other: a valid work permit
